model.name: Unify Traceability Units with the M2 UML/TS Model
model.goal: UML/TS elements are typed OOP-extension VIEWS of the ONE existing ScenarioUnit (DRY, instanceOf multi-facet — NOT copies), usage-tracked. R36.1 UmlUseCase, R36.2 UmlClass/tsClass, R36.3 Method-enrich+Method-vs-Function, R36.4 UmlTraceRelationship extends TraceLink, R36.5 Scenario/Edit→base + usedIn. Follows S35.

phases.title: Typed-OOP-ext base (Uml*/ts* instanceOf facets extend the existing units, DRY not copies) + usedIn usage-ref tracking + R36.5 Scenario/Edit-opens-correct-base-unit. BUILD FIRST (T36.5).
Method enrichment (full signature/visibility/return/docs) + Method-vs-Function (parentClass present=Method/absent=Function, one-way convert) + Uml/ts projections. Underpins projections (T36.3).
Projections + drag-onto-diagram: UmlUseCase ext UseCase (T36.1) + UmlClass/tsClass ext Class (T36.2). A-MERGE tree-preserving — HARD AC-tree-unchanged byte-diff==0 pre/post-merge (Tron).
UmlTraceRelationship extends TraceLink — typed RawBin decompose/trace connector (UseCase -> Method), reuse R32.6 edges. BUILD LAST (T36.4).
